faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Private Tours, booking, guides, and our premium experiences
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our private tour experiences
faq.contactDescription: Our team is ready to help you plan your perfect Private Tours experience.

q1.question: How do I book a tour?
q1.answer: Booking a tour is simple and fully online. You select your preferred experience, date, language, and group size through our booking platform. Once your booking is confirmed, you will receive a detailed confirmation email with meeting details, contact information, and practical guidance. If you have specific interests or requests, these can be shared during the booking process so your guide can tailor the experience accordingly.

q2.question: How far in advance should I book?
q2.answer: We recommend booking as early as possible, especially during peak travel seasons such as spring, summer, and major holidays. Many of our guides are in high demand due to their expertise and limited availability. While last-minute bookings are sometimes possible, advance booking ensures access to your preferred guide, language, and time slot.

q3.question: Can I book for a group?
q3.answer: Yes. All our tours are private and designed for individuals, couples, families, or larger groups. Group size can be selected during booking, and the experience will be adjusted to suit your group's interests and pace. For larger groups or corporate bookings, we recommend contacting us directly so we can ensure the best possible setup.

q4.question: Do I need to print my ticket?
q4.answer: No. Printed tickets are not required. Your booking confirmation is sent digitally and can be shown on your phone or tablet. Your guide will already have your booking details and will meet you at the agreed location.

q5.question: What if I'm traveling alone?
q5.answer: Solo travelers are very welcome. Many guests choose Private Tours specifically for the personal attention and flexibility that a private experience provides. The content, pacing, and focus of the tour will be fully adapted to your interests.

q1.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q1.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards, including Visa and Mastercard. All payments are processed securely through our booking platform using encrypted payment solutions. Full payment is required at the time of booking to confirm your reservation.

q2.question: What does the price include?
q2.answer: The price includes a private, guided experience led by an authorized professional, all planning and preparation, and hosting throughout the tour. Where applicable, logistics and transportation coordination are included. Any additional costs such as meals, entrance fees, or third-party services will be clearly stated in advance.

q3.question: Are there any hidden fees?
q3.answer: No. All prices are transparent and clearly stated during booking. If optional extras are available, these are always presented separately so you can make informed choices.

q1.question: What is your cancellation policy?
q1.answer: Cancellations made more than 48 hours before the scheduled start time receive a full refund. Cancellations made 24-48 hours before the tour receive a partial refund. Cancellations within 24 hours of the tour start time are non-refundable, as guides and logistics are already fully committed.

q2.question: Can I reschedule my tour?
q2.answer: Yes, subject to guide availability. We recommend contacting us as early as possible if you need to reschedule. While we cannot guarantee availability for new dates, we always do our best to accommodate changes.

q3.question: What happens if the tour is canceled by you?
q3.answer: In the unlikely event that we need to cancel a tour, you will be offered a full refund or the option to reschedule at no additional cost.

q1.question: How long do tours last?
q1.answer: Most tours last between 2 and 4 hours, depending on the experience you choose. Duration is clearly stated during booking, and private tours allow for flexibility if you wish to explore certain topics in more depth.

q2.question: What languages are tours offered in?
q2.answer: Tours are offered in Swedish, English, and German. Each guide is professionally certified in the language they offer to ensure clarity, nuance, and a high-quality experience.

q3.question: Are tours suitable for children?
q3.answer: Yes. Tours can be adapted for families with children. Please let us know the age range when booking so your guide can adjust content and pacing accordingly.

q4.question: Do tours run in all weather conditions?
q4.answer: Yes. Tours operate year-round and in most weather conditions. We recommend dressing appropriately for the season. In case of extreme weather, we will contact you in advance to discuss alternatives.

q5.question: Is transportation included?
q5.answer: Transportation details vary depending on the tour. When included, this will be clearly stated in the tour description. Your guide will always assist with logistics to ensure a smooth experience.

q1.question: Who are your guides?
q1.answer: Our guides are authorized professionals and subject-matter experts, many with academic backgrounds in history, archaeology, or cultural studies. All guides are carefully vetted to ensure deep knowledge, strong communication skills, and professional hosting.

q2.question: Are your guides licensed?
q2.answer: Yes. We work exclusively with licensed guides or verified experts. Credentials and language certifications are reviewed as part of our selection process.

q3.question: Will the same guide stay with us throughout the tour?
q3.answer: Yes. Your guide is there to host you throughout the experience, creating continuity and a relaxed, personal atmosphere. In the rare cases where an experience involves multiple guides or distinct stages, this will always be clearly stated beforehand, ensuring full transparency and peace of mind.

q1.question: Are tours accessible for guests with mobility needs?
q1.answer: We want everyone to feel comfortable and welcome on our tours. Accessibility details are clearly outlined in each tour description, so you can easily see walking distances, terrain, and physical requirements in advance. Many of our experiences can accommodate mobility needs, and we are always happy to help. If you have any specific wishes or questions, please do not hesitate to contact us and we will gladly guide you toward the most suitable option.

q2.question: What should I bring?
q2.answer: Comfortable walking shoes and weather-appropriate clothing are recommended. Any additional requirements will be communicated in your booking confirmation.

q3.question: How do I contact you before or during the tour?
q3.answer: You can reach us via email or phone using the contact details provided in your confirmation email. Your guide's contact information will also be included for day-of coordination.

story.label: WHO WE ARE
story.imageAlt: A charming narrow alley in Stockholm's Old Town
story.paragraph1: Private Tours was created for travelers who value depth, trust, and personal connection over volume and speed.
story.paragraph2: We offer private, expertly hosted experiences in Stockholm led exclusively by authorized professionals. Every guide is carefully selected, every route is curated, and every experience is designed to feel seamless from start to finish. This is not an open marketplace — it is a considered collection of people and places chosen for their knowledge, integrity, and ability to host with confidence.
story.paragraph3: Our guests are not looking for more options. They are looking for the right one.
story.paragraph4: That is why we work only with licensed guides and subject-matter experts who are fluent in your language and deeply familiar with the city they represent. By taking full responsibility for logistics, pacing, and content, we remove friction and allow you to focus entirely on the experience itself.
story.paragraph5: Many of our tours combine historical expertise with hands-on activities — such as Swedish culinary culture — because understanding a place is often best done through both story and action. Throughout the journey, your host remains with you, providing context, continuity, and personal attention.
story.paragraph6: Private Tours exists to make time in Stockholm feel meaningful, effortless, and personal — guided by people who genuinely care about both their craft and their guests.

responsibleTourism.label: OUR COMMITMENT
responsibleTourism.imageAlt: Stockholm waterfront with nature and historic architecture
responsibleTourism.title: A Commitment to Responsible Tourism
responsibleTourism.paragraph1: Private Tours is committed to operating with care for both people and places. We collaborate with local professionals and businesses, maintain a low-impact private-only model, and design experiences that respect the environments and communities we visit.
responsibleTourism.paragraph2: Accessibility matters to us. Our digital platforms follow recognized accessibility standards, and our routes are designed to be inclusive whenever possible — without compromising depth or quality.
responsibleTourism.paragraph3: Cultural heritage is not a backdrop; it is a responsibility. Our work is grounded in education, preservation, and long-term respect for the stories we share.

parties.title: Parties
parties.content: These Terms & Conditions (the "Terms") form an agreement between the customer ("you", "the Customer") and Yellow Molly Aktiebolag, organisationsnummer 559577-5080, with registered address Karlavägen 18, 114 31 Stockholm, Sweden, trading as Private Tours ("we", "us", "the Supplier"). The full registered identity, including VAT number and competent court, is set out in the company-info card below. You can reach us at info@privatetours.se.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.content: "Supplier" means Yellow Molly Aktiebolag, the operator that provides the guided tour. "Booking Platform" means Bokun, operated by Tripadvisor LLC, which we use for online checkout, voucher delivery and supplier administration. "Payment Processor" means Bokun Pay, powered by Adyen N.V. as acquiring bank, which processes card and alternative-method payments on the Supplier's behalf. "Customer" means the person who completes a booking. "Participant" means each person attending the tour under that booking. "Tour" means the guided experience described on the relevant product page on privatetours.se.

service.title: The Service
service.content: We provide guided tours in Stockholm and other locations as described on the relevant product page. Each tour page sets out the duration, itinerary, meeting point, included items and exclusions. Unless explicitly stated, prices do not include transport to the meeting point, food and drink, optional museum tickets, or personal travel insurance. Meeting points are confirmed in your booking voucher; please arrive at least ten minutes before the start time.

booking.title: How to Book
booking.intro: Bookings are made through our Booking Platform (Bokun) on privatetours.se. When you book:
items: You must be at least 18 years old and have authority to accept these Terms on behalf of all Participants in your booking.
All booking details (names, contact email, dates, group size) must be accurate and complete.
A booking is confirmed only when Bokun issues a voucher to the email address you provided. Until that voucher is issued, availability is not guaranteed.
You may be asked to show the voucher (printed or on a phone) and a valid ID at the meeting point.

pricing.title: Prices, Currency and Taxes
pricing.content: Prices are shown on each tour page in Swedish Kronor (SEK) and include applicable Swedish VAT (moms). No additional currencies beyond SEK are offered at this time. If the Booking Platform displays a converted price in another currency, that conversion is provided by the Booking Platform for your convenience and the SEK amount on our website governs the contract. The price displayed at the moment you complete checkout is the price that applies to your booking.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content: Payment is processed by Bokun Pay, powered by Adyen N.V., on the Supplier's behalf. The accepted payment methods are those displayed at checkout by the Booking Platform and may change over time. Your card or chosen method is charged at the time of booking. A receipt is issued by the Booking Platform on the Supplier's behalf and sent to the email address you provided. We are not the merchant of record for the card transaction itself; payment-network rules and Adyen's terms apply to the processing of the payment.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and Refunds
cancellation.intro: Cancellation rules are set per tour and are displayed at checkout before you confirm payment. Those per-tour rules form part of these Terms by reference. In addition:
items: If we cancel a confirmed tour for any reason, you will be offered a full refund of the price paid or the option to reschedule, at your choice.
Where a refund is due, it is processed by Adyen back to the original payment method. Refunds typically appear within 5–10 business days, depending on your card issuer or payment method.
Voluntary changes you request after booking (date, group size, name change) are subject to the per-tour rules displayed at checkout and any service fees the Booking Platform applies.

withdrawalExclusion.title: No 14-Day Right of Withdrawal for Dated Tours
withdrawalExclusion.content: The 14-day right of withdrawal under the Swedish Distance Contracts Act does not apply to bookings of dated leisure activities. This exception is set out in 2 kap. 11 § p. 12 distansavtalslagen (2005:59). Once a tour for a specified date has been booked and confirmed, the per-tour cancellation rules displayed at checkout apply instead of the general 14-day withdrawal right.

modifications.title: Modifications by the Customer
modifications.content: Requests to change the date, time, group size, or named lead Participant after a booking is confirmed are accommodated subject to availability and the per-tour rules displayed at checkout. The Booking Platform may apply administration or service fees to such changes. Name changes for additional Participants in the same booking are normally free of charge but must be communicated in advance of the tour.

forceMajeure.title: Force Majeure and Operator Cancellation
forceMajeure.content: We may cancel or reschedule a tour where circumstances beyond our reasonable control make it unsafe or impractical to operate. Examples include severe weather, transport strikes, public-authority orders, public-health restrictions, civil unrest, or acts of God. In such cases you will be offered a full refund of the price paid or a reschedule, at your choice. We are not liable for any ancillary costs you may incur (such as flights, hotels, parking, or other tickets) as a result of an operator-side cancellation.

participantObligations.title: Participant Obligations
participantObligations.intro: By participating in a tour, each Participant agrees to:
items: Provide accurate booking information and arrive at the meeting point on time.
Follow the guide's instructions and any safety briefings.
Behave respectfully towards other Participants, the guide, residents and the public spaces visited.

Refrain from participating while under the influence of alcohol or drugs to a degree that compromises safety or the experience of others; the guide may refuse participation in such cases without refund.
Self-assess fitness and health for any tour described as physically active and notify us in advance of relevant medical conditions or accessibility needs.
Accept that incidental photography or video may be taken during the tour for our promotional use; if you do not wish to appear, please tell the guide before the tour starts.

minors.title: Minors
minors.content: You must be at least 18 years old to make a booking. Participants under 18 are welcome on tours but must be accompanied by a booking adult who takes responsibility for their conduct, safety and fitness for the activity.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Participation in a tour is at your own risk. We are liable for direct loss caused by our own negligence or wilful misconduct. To the extent permitted by mandatory consumer-protection law, our total liability arising from or in connection with a booking is capped at the price paid for that booking. We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, including (without limitation) loss of profit, loss of opportunity, or onward travel costs. We strongly recommend that you hold personal travel insurance covering medical costs, cancellation, and personal effects.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.content: All content on privatetours.se — including written material, images, audio, video, route maps, and itineraries — is owned by us or our licensors and is protected by copyright and related rights. You may view and print pages for your personal, non-commercial use. Any other use, including reproduction, redistribution, or use to train automated systems, requires our prior written consent. If you share photos or videos taken on a tour with us (for example by tagging us on social media or replying to a request from our team), you grant us a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to use that content in our own promotional channels with attribution where reasonable.

privacy.title: Privacy and Sub-Processors
privacy.content: Your personal data is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. To deliver bookings, payments, mapping and email confirmations we use the following sub-processors: Bokun (Tripadvisor LLC) for the booking platform, Adyen N.V. for payment acquiring through Bokun Pay, Google LLC for map display, Vercel Inc. for website hosting and edge delivery, Supabase Inc. for database hosting in the EU, and Resend for transactional email. The Privacy Policy explains the lawful basis for each processing activity, retention periods, and how to exercise your data-subject rights.

complaints.title: Complaints and Dispute Resolution
complaints.content: If something goes wrong, please tell us as soon as possible — ideally during or immediately after the tour — by emailing info@privatetours.se. We aim to acknowledge complaints within five business days and to provide a substantive reply within thirty days. If you remain dissatisfied with our handling of a complaint, you may refer the matter to the Swedish National Board for Consumer Disputes, Allmänna reklamationsnämnden (ARN), www.arn.se. EU consumers may also use the European Commission's Online Dispute Resolution platform at https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law and Venue
governingLaw.content: These Terms and any contract formed under them are governed by Swedish law. Disputes that cannot be resolved through negotiation, ARN, or the EU ODR platform shall be heard before Stockholms tingsrätt as the court of first instance, without prejudice to any mandatory rights you have as a consumer to bring proceedings in the courts of your country of residence.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
changes.content: We may update these Terms from time to time, for example to reflect changes in law, the Booking Platform, or our operational practice. The effective date of the current version is shown as "Last updated" at the top of this page. Updates apply to bookings made on or after the effective date; bookings already confirmed remain governed by the version of the Terms accepted at the time of booking.

acceptance.title: Acceptance and Language
acceptance.content: By completing checkout you confirm that you have read, understood and accepted these Terms on behalf of yourself and all Participants in your booking. These Terms are published in English, Swedish (svenska) and German (Deutsch). The Swedish version is the legally binding text; the English and German versions are courtesy translations. In case of any conflict or inconsistency between language versions, the Swedish text prevails.

step2.title: Confirmation
step2.description: We review your request and confirm the applicable refund tier within 24 hours.

step3.title: Refund Processed

block1.title: Standard Terms
block1.content: All cancellation requests must be submitted in writing via email or through your booking confirmation link. Verbal cancellations are not accepted. The cancellation time is calculated from the scheduled tour start time.

block2.title: Group Bookings
block2.content: For group bookings of 8 or more participants, cancellation must be made at least 72 hours in advance for a full refund. Partial cancellations reducing the group below the minimum size may be subject to adjusted pricing.

block3.title: Weather & Force Majeure
block3.content: In the event of severe weather or force majeure circumstances, we will offer a full refund or free rebooking at your convenience. Our guides monitor conditions and will proactively contact you if a tour cannot safely proceed.

block4.title: Refund Timeline
block4.content: Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days from approval. Credit card refunds may take an additional 1–3 billing cycles to appear on your statement depending on your financial institution.

cta.title: Questions About Our Policy?
